## What it is

An open universal phone carrier for overhead recording. Print one and retain the phone with two ordinary elastic bands.

## Design notes

The 84 x 174 x 14 mm envelope covers the iPhone 12 mini through iPhone 17 Pro Max and Pixel 10 Pro XL with moderate cases. A 14 mm lower ledge supports narrow phones; the upper-left rear-camera region stays completely open. Four slots take two replaceable elastic bands over the screen. Three 60 mm mount slots let an M6 bolt adjust both sideways and fore-aft for different rear-camera layouts, centering the selected lens rather than merely the phone body.

Three sub-1 mm² faces are expected corner triangles from the 1 mm polish pass.

## Don't

Do not use a fixed-width snap fit: it excludes future phones and printed springs creep. Do not add an upper-left support where it could enter an iPhone or Pixel camera view.
